caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a single curved handle attached from the top of the neck to the shoulder of the vessel. The jug is decorated with marbled patterns in shades of brown and bluish-gray, creating a swirled appearance across its surface. The rim of the jug is fitted with a flat, metallic-looking (possibly silver) lid. The jug is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or decorative elements. Beneath the jug, slightly to the right, there is a small printed or written name: "Ursula Uyldert."
title: Earthen Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
